description: This file defines the AuditTrailManager class, which manages audit trail events including recording, retrieving, and trimming events, as well as describing event categories and individual events within the OrchardCore CMS framework.

classes.name: AuditTrailManager
classes.description: Manages audit trail events including recording, retrieving, describing categories and events, and trimming old events within OrchardCore.

methods.name: RecordEventAsync
methods.description: Records a new audit trail event asynchronously, invoking event handlers and saving the event to the database.

methods.name: GetEventAsync
methods.description: Retrieves an audit trail event by its unique ID asynchronously.

methods.name: TrimEventsAsync
methods.description: Deletes audit trail events older than a specified retention period asynchronously.

methods.name: DescribeEvent
methods.description: Provides a descriptor for a given audit trail event.

methods.name: DescribeCategories
methods.description: Returns all category descriptors for audit trail events.

methods.name: DescribeCategory
methods.description: Provides a descriptor for a specific category by name.

methods.name: DescribeEvent (private)
methods.description: Provides a descriptor for an event given its name and category.

methods.name: GetClientIpAddressAsync
methods.description: Retrieves the client IP address if allowed by settings.

methods.name: GetAuditTrailSettingsAsync
methods.description: Fetches the current audit trail settings from the site configuration.

methods.name: IsEventEnabledAsync
methods.description: Determines if a specific event descriptor is enabled based on settings.
